Question 7
?

What is the gradient of the product f(x,y)h(x,y) if f(x,y)=xey and h(x,y)=yex?

a
(x+1)yex i+x(1+y)ey j
b
(x+y)yexy i+x(x+y)exy j
c
(x+y)ex+y i+(x+y)ex+y j
d
xyexy i+(x+1)(1+y)exy j
e
(x+1)yex+y i+x(1+y)ex+y j
Submit
